#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int pos(const std::vector<char>& s, int a, int b, int c, int k) {
    int ret = 0;
    for (char x : s) {
        if (x == 'V') {
            if (a == 0) {
                if (k == 0) return ret;
                ret++;
            } else {
                a--;
            }
        } else if (x == 'K') {
            if (b == 0) {
                if (k == 1) return ret;
                ret++;
            } else {
                b--;
            }
        } else {
            if (c == 0) {
                if (k == 2) return ret;
                ret++;
            } else {
                c--;
            }
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    std::string sLine;
    cin >> sLine;
    std::vector<char> s(sLine.begin(), sLine.end());

    int maxN = n + 1;
    std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>>> dp(3, std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>>(maxN, std::vector<std::vector<int>>(maxN, std::vector<int>(maxN, INT_MAX))));
    int countV = 0, countK = 0, countE = 0;
    for (char c : s) {
        if (c == 'V') countV++;
        else if (c == 'K') countK++;
        else countE++;
    }

    dp[2][0][0][0] = 0;
    std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>>> poss(3, std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>>(countV + 1, std::vector<std::vector<int>>(countK + 1, std::vector<int>(countE + 1, -1))));
    for (int i = 0; i <= countV; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= countK; ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= countE; ++k) {
                for (int l = 0; l < 3; ++l) {
                    poss[l][i][j][k] = pos(s, i, j, k, l);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i <= countV; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= countK; ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= countE; ++k) {
                if (i + 1 <= countV && poss[0][i][j][k] != -1) {
                    int v = poss[0][i][j][k];
                    if (dp[2][i][j][k] != INT_MAX)
                        dp[0][i + 1][j][k] = std::min(dp[0][i + 1][j][k], dp[2][i][j][k] + v);
                    if (dp[1][i][j][k] != INT_MAX)
                        dp[0][i + 1][j][k] = std::min(dp[0][i + 1][j][k], dp[1][i][j][k] + v);
                    if (dp[0][i][j][k] != INT_MAX)
                        dp[0][i + 1][j][k] = std::min(dp[0][i + 1][j][k], dp[0][i][j][k] + v);
                }
                if (j + 1 <= countK && poss[1][i][j][k] != -1) {
                    int v = poss[1][i][j][k];
                    if (dp[2][i][j][k] != INT_MAX)
                        dp[1][i][j + 1][k] = std::min(dp[1][i][j + 1][k], dp[2][i][j][k] + v);
                    if (dp[1][i][j][k] != INT_MAX)
                        dp[1][i][j + 1][k] = std::min(dp[1][i][j + 1][k], dp[1][i][j][k] + v);
                }
                if (k + 1 <= countE && poss[2][i][j][k] != -1) {
                    int v = poss[2][i][j][k];
                    if (dp[2][i][j][k] != INT_MAX)
                        dp[2][i][j][k + 1] = std::min(dp[2][i][j][k + 1], dp[2][i][j][k] + v);
                    if (dp[1][i][j][k] != INT_MAX)
                        dp[2][i][j][k + 1] = std::min(dp[2][i][j][k + 1], dp[1][i][j][k] + v);
                    if (dp[0][i][j][k] != INT_MAX)
                        dp[2][i][j][k + 1] = std::min(dp[2][i][j][k + 1], dp[0][i][j][k] + v);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int answer = std::min({dp[0][countV][countK][countE], dp[1][countV][countK][countE], dp[2][countV][countK][countE]});
    std::cout << answer << "\n";

    return 0;
}
